== The Dragon Faction ==
[[File:DragonChampionTrophy.png|left|Dragon Champion Trophy]]
[[File:DragonSpellUpgrade.png|right|54x54px|Dragon's Roar]]
The Dragons were implemented during the ''[[Updates#2.3 Ancient Eternals|Ancient Eternals]]'' expansion (v2.3), and can be unlocked after reincarnating at R46. Grand and mighty, they demand to be played alongside a Neutral faction, and feature a Heritage that persists through [[reincarnations]] and becomes stronger the more you abide with them.

The dragons refuse to be mingled with any [[Vanilla]] or other [[Prestige]] faction.
* '''[[Alignment]]:''' '''''Prestige''''' (Neutral)
* '''[[Spells|Faction Spell]]:''' '''''Dragon's Breath''''' - Activates one of the following five effects at random for 20 seconds.
{{Breaths}}
* '''[[Spells#Spell Upgrades|Spell Upgrade]]:''' '''''Dragon's Roar''''' - ''Dragon's Breath'' also produces Faction Coins based on its activity time. 
** Unlock requirement: Cast ''Dragon's Breath'' while having at least 4 other active spells.
* [[Heritage|'''Heritage''']]: Increases assistant production based on all-time spent affiliated with Dragons.<br />{{Formula|(0.55 * x^{0.55})%|hours affiliated with dragon at all R's}}
* [[Bloodline|'''Bloodline''']]: Increase the production of all buildings based on Faction Coin find chance.<br />{{Formula|4 * (x^{0.4})|your Faction Coin find chance}}
* '''[[Challenge|Challenge Reward]]''': '''''Prismatic Breath''''' - While all 5 breaths are active, Reincarnations count double for all purposes.
* '''[[Unique Building]]''': '''''Wyrm's Den''''' (from Iron Strongholds)
* '''Faction Unlock Requirements''': R46 + See [[Dragon#Unlock Requirements|below]].

== Unlock Requirements ==
[[File:Advisor-dragon_hatch-message.png|right|300px]]
At [[Reincarnation|R46]]+, to unlock the Dragon Faction, players will have to [[excavate]] the dragon egg, and raise it into an elder dragon.

Each item below can be unlocked in separate game plays, and only need to be bought once throughout the entire game play. You can Abdicate and Reincarnate during the 12 hour wait of all 4 stages.

== Unique Building  ==
[[File:Dragon_Unique_Building_Design.png|thumb|left]]
The Dragons ''Iron Strongholds'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Wyrm's Den''''', which is required for some [[challenges]] and research quests. [[File:DragonUniqueBuilding.png|right]]{{clr}}
